user.title: Connect to Meter MACS
user.description:
Meter MACS added a human check to its sign-in page, so Home Assistant can't sign in for you. It takes about a minute:

1. [Open the Meter MACS portal]({portal_url}) in a new tab and sign in. Tick **remember me** if you see it.
2. On that tab, open your browser's developer tools: **F12**, or **Cmd+Option+I** on a Mac.
3. Go to **Application** (Chrome and Edge) or **Storage** (Firefox and Safari), then **Cookies**, then **{portal_url}**.
4. Click the cookie named **{cookie_name}** and copy its value.
5. Paste it below.

Close the portal tab when you're done rather than signing out. Signing out ends the session Home Assistant uses.

data_description.session_token: The long value of the {cookie_name} cookie. You can also paste the whole cookie line; the right part is picked out automatically.
